fact_text: Certified battery range is 110 km per charge under IDC standard testing.
Fast charger replenishes battery from 0% to 80% in 45 minutes.
ClaimLoom Pro Plan subscription price is $29/month or $290/year.
Standard product warranty covers 3 years or 30,000 km.
Official brand hex palette is Indium Blue (#1E3A8A) and Stark Orange (#FF5500).
Enterprise service level agreement guarantees 99.9% uptime.
Refer to product users as Creators or Team Members.
Text contrast must meet at least 4.5:1 under WCAG AA.
LinkedIn copy should be professional and avoid hype slang or excessive hashtags.
Instagram captions should be concise and contain no raw URLs in the caption body.
Billboard copy should contain no more than 12 words and no clickable link prompts.
Marketing email copy should state a clear value proposition and avoid spam-trigger phrasing.
Use the approved colors Indium Blue (#1E3A8A), Stark Orange (#FF5500), White (#FFFFFF), and Slate (#0F172A).
